enchants.name: Quality
enchants.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Sparks
enchants.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Artisan Enchanter's Moxie
enchants.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Concentration
enchants.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Knowledge
enchants.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Skill
enchants.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Multicraft
enchants.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Resourcefulness
enchants.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

enchants.name: Ingenuity
enchants.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
enchants.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

notes: Generated from the secure Blizzard Game Data API importer.
Blizzard API credentials are never placed in browser JavaScript.
The importer does not scan the historical weapon/armor catalog.
Season membership is source-based, not guessed from item level.
Season 2 PvE candidates come from matched Adventure Journal sources.
Season 2 PvP candidates come from Blizzard's PvP Season 2 reward API.
Current Midnight profession recipes are imported for gems, enchants, crafted gear, and other crafted outputs.
Midnight Season 2 upgrade tracks, Mistcrests, exchange rules, and Ascendant Venomstone eligibility are stored explicitly; upgrade tracks are not inferred from item level.
Unified item records retain their source category so the optimizer can distinguish PvE and PvP gear.
Season 2+ additions such as Kith'ix and Labyrinth of Kindo'jan are added when Blizzard exposes their reward data.
Crafted, vendor, outdoor, Delves, Prey, and other non-Journal sources require their own source-specific importers; they are not silently approximated as Season 2 gear.

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Blacksmith's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Shatter Essence
recipes.description:
Shatter a magical essence of Midnight to utilize the power within for your Enchanting.

Gain the following effect when shattering:

 Shattered Essence:
Empowered by a shattered magical essence of Midnight, increasing Resourcefulness, Ingenuity, and Multicraft while practicing Midnight Enchanting.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Dawn Shatter
recipes.description: Disenchant a Dawn Crystal, reducing it to 3 Radiant Shards. The quality of Radiant Shards produced is limited by the quality of Dawn Crystal used, and is otherwise based on a combination of your Enchanting skill and Shard Supplier specialization.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Radiant Shatter
recipes.description: Disenchant a Radiant Shard, reducing it to 3 Eversinging Dust. The quality of Eversinging Dust produced is limited by the quality of Radiant Shard used, and is otherwise based on a combination of your Enchanting skill and Dust Deliverer specialization.

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Enchanter's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Recraft Equipment
recipes.description: Allows you to change the Optional Reagents and quality of equipment crafted with Midnight Tailoring.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Tailor's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Scribe's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Midnight Milling

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Leatherworker's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Alchemist's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Recraft Equipment
recipes.description: Allows you to change the Optional Reagents and quality of equipment crafted with Midnight Jewelcrafting.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Quality
recipes.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Sparks
recipes.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Artisan Jewelcrafter's Moxie
recipes.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Concentration
recipes.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Knowledge
recipes.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Skill
recipes.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Multicraft
recipes.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Resourcefulness
recipes.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

recipes.name: Ingenuity
recipes.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
recipes.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Quality
otherOutputs.description:
Quality can affect items in several ways. Reagents and commodities can either be low quality or high quality, while equipment can have five levels of quality.

Reagent quality will make it easier to hit higher qualities in any craft, while higher quality commodities will have more potent effects.

Equipment will have a higher item level with every quality increase.

The final quality of a craft will be determined through a combination of Skill, reagent quality, specialization bonuses, and Recipe Difficulty.

Stories say that crafters have been known to reach beyond their limits by Concentrating...
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Sparks
otherOutputs.description:
Sparks are a special reagent used for high-end equipment crafts. They are found in limited quantities as each season progresses. At the start of a season a new, unique Spark can be found.

If you fall behind on acquiring Sparks, you may find them by completing max-level content such as Delves, Mythic Plus, Raids, Instanced PvP, and some outdoor events.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Artisan Enchanter's Moxie
otherOutputs.description: Artisan's Moxie is the coalescence of a crafter's knowledge and experience. It can be traded for recipes, reagents, and single-use tomes of Knowledge. Artisan's Moxie can be sourced from first-time crafting bonuses, Patron Order rewards, and knowledge points.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Concentration
otherOutputs.description: Concentration lets a crafter focus hard enough to break their limits and push their craft to the next quality level. In some cases, the crafter can experience an "ingenious breakthrough" and have a portion of the spent Concentration refunded. More Concentration can be refunded through spending knowledge points in certain specializations. The higher your Ingenuity, the more likely you are to have an ingenious breakthrough.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Knowledge
otherOutputs.description: Knowledge points are spent on Specializations. Specializations grant access to new recipes, stat bonuses, and more. Knowledge points are earned from first-time crafts, quest rewards, and occasionally treasures.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Skill
otherOutputs.description:
Skill increases the quality a recipe will be crafted at. Recipe Difficulty will indicate how much Skill is needed to craft that recipe at the highest quality. Skill can be leveled up to 100 by crafting various recipes.

To further augment your Skill, try equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Lastly, spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Skill related to those recipes.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Multicraft
otherOutputs.description: Multicraft increases the chance of crafting additional items. Reagents and consumables can yield additional items while equipment cannot. Multicraft can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Multicraft related to those recipes.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Resourcefulness
otherOutputs.description: Resourcefulness increases the chance of using fewer reagents in a craft. Only reagents that are not bound to you can be affected. Resourcefulness can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Resourcefulness related to those recipes.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

otherOutputs.name: Ingenuity
otherOutputs.description: Ingenuity increases the chance of having Concentration refunded during a craft. This phenomenon is called an "ingenious breakthrough". Ingenuity can be increased by equipping a Professions tool and accessories. Spending knowledge points to specialize in certain crafts can boost Ingenuity related to those recipes.
otherOutputs.source: Blizzard Game Data API — current Midnight profession recipe

Your Bloodlust spell now has a 60 sec cooldown, but increases Haste by 15%, and only affects you and your friendly target when cast for 10 sec.

In addition, Bloodlust is no longer affected by Sated.
Sundering summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec that increases the critical effect of damage and healing spells of all nearby allies within 40 yards by 15% for 15 sec.

Summons a totem at your feet for 15 sec.

Whenever enemies within 20 yards of the totem deal direct damage, the totem will deal 100% of the damage dealt back to attacker.
Summons a totem at your feet that will redirect all harmful spells cast within 30 yards on a nearby party or raid member to itself. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 3 sec.
Summons a totem with 4% of your health at the target location for 6 sec that forms a circuit of electricity that enemies cannot pass through.

Burrow beneath the ground, becoming unattackable, removing movement impairing effects, and increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

When the effect ends, enemies within 6 yards are knocked in the air and take 2,171 Physical damage.
When you successfully Purge a beneficial effect, the enemy suffers 3,733 Nature damage over 3 sec.
Grips the target in lightning, stunning and dealing 17,268 Nature damage over 5 sec while the target is lassoed. Can move while channeling.
Transcendence: Transfer can now be cast if you are stunned. Cooldown reduced by 15 sec if you are not.
Removing hostile magic effects from a target increases the healing they receive from you by 10% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

Your healing has a chance to coalesces a Healing Sphere out of the mists at your target's location after 1.5 sec. If allies walk through it, they consume the sphere, healing themselves for 2,598 and dispelling all harmful periodic magic effects.

Thunder Focus Tea provides immunity to Silence and Interrupt effects for 5 sec.
Revival's cooldown is reduced by 16%, and provides immunity to magical damage and harmful effects for 2 sec.
Demateralize into mist while stunned, reducing damage taken by 30%. Each second you remain stunned reduces this bonus by 10%.
You perform a Mighty Ox Kick, hurling your enemy a distance behind you.

Soothing Mist, Crackling Jade Lightning, and Rising Sun Kick form a sphere of Hope or Despair above their targets. Only one of each sphere can be active at a time.

 Sphere of Hope: Increases your healing done to the target by 10%.
 Sphere of Despair: Target deals 3% less damage and takes 10% increased damage from all sources.
Celestial Conduit now prevents all crowd control for its duration.
Your Consecration clears and suppresses all snare effects on allies within its area of effect.

Your Divine Steed lasts for an additional 2 sec.

While active you become immune to movement impairing effects, and you knock back enemies that you move through.
Reduces the cooldown of your Blessing of Protection and Blessing of Sacrifice by 33%.
Empowers the friendly target with the spirit of the forgotten queen, causing the target to be immune to all damage for 6 sec.
Your Flash of Light reduces all damage the target receives by 10% for 6 sec. Stacks up to 2 times.

You focus the assault on this target, increasing their damage taken by 3% for 10 sec. Each unique player that attacks the target increases the damage taken by an additional 3%, stacking up to 6 times.

Instantly clears all bleeds, poisons, and diseases from the target, and heals for 18% damage over 6 sec.
